_comment: `registries` is merged into components.json by the UI stack setup task: add missing keys, never overwrite the project's own. URLs are from https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json, checked 2026-10-14. catalogue.md (beside this file) says when to use each. The house registry is NOT a namespace: components.json namespaces must be URL templates, so house items are installed by GitHub address (see `house`).

house.access: Private repo: the shadcn CLI uses the GitHub CLI login (`gh auth login`, once per machine), or GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained, Contents: read-only) in CI. Git's own login isn't used.
